name: Universal
source: NGX audited annual report, Universal Insurance Plc 2024 Annual Report, consolidated statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income, printed page 66 (_ngx_pdf/UNIVINSURE.pdf). CORRECTED 2026-10-04: the stored columns were labelled one financial year ahead of the document, so the column shown as FY2025 is the printed 31-Dec-24 Group column and the column shown as FY2024 is the printed 31-Dec-23 Group column. The column shown as FY2023 was a byte copy of the FY2024 column and is dropped rather than guessed. The two older columns keep their own figures under the same one-year shift. Confirmed against the filed accounts by press coverage of the FY2025 audited results (Insurance Revenue 20.43bn and Profit Before Tax 2.18bn for FY2025 against 13.76bn and 1.98bn for FY2024), which is why the newest column cannot be FY2025.
